description: This PHP class 'Delimiter' is part of the PhpSpreadsheet library, responsible for detecting the delimiter used in CSV files by analyzing the content of the file, counting potential delimiter characters, and inferring the most likely delimiter based on statistical measures.

classes.name: Delimiter
classes.description: A class that detects the delimiter character in a CSV file by analyzing the first lines of the file and calculating the most probable delimiter based on statistical deviations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Delimiter object with a file handle, escape character, and enclosure, then counts potential delimiters.

methods.name: linesCounted
methods.description: Returns the number of lines processed during delimiter detection.

methods.name: countPotentialDelimiters
methods.description: Reads lines from the file and counts the occurrence of potential delimiters.

methods.name: countDelimiterValues
methods.description: Counts how many times each potential delimiter appears in a given line.

methods.name: infer
methods.description: Calculates the mean square deviation for each potential delimiter and infers the most likely delimiter.

methods.name: getNextLine
methods.description: Reads the next full line from the file, properly handling enclosed text to avoid false positives.
